firstRunTitle: No scans on this account yet
firstRunBody: Put a hostname in the box above and hit Scan. The first run takes a few seconds and lands in your history automatically, so you can diff it against the next one.
firstRunStep1: Findings arrive sorted by severity, with the evidence that triggered each one.
firstRunStep2: Export the report as JSON, CSV or PDF, or hand out a read-only share link.
firstRunStep3: Rescan from history whenever you ship, and watch the counts move.
recentEmpty: Nothing in the last window. Run a scan above and it lands here.
patternsLater: Patterns show up here once a few more scans are on record.
activityErrorBody: Your scans are unaffected. This is the summary above the scanner, not the scanner itself.
announceComplete: Scan complete: {count, plural, =0 {no findings} one {# finding} other {# findings}}.
announceStillRunning: This scan is still running. It will appear in History when it finishes.
